facts.text: Through the Richmond Guarantee, every continuing undergraduate student in the School of Arts & Sciences, Jepson School of Leadership Studies, and Robins School of Business is eligible to receive one fellowship of up to $5,500 for a summer internship or faculty-mentored research project.

sources.title: Richmond Guarantee - University of Richmond
sources.quote: Every continuing undergraduate student in the School of Arts & Sciences, Jepson School of Leadership Studies, and the Robins School of Business is eligible to receive one fellowship of up to $5,500 for a summer internship or faculty-mentored research project

facts.text: Under the Richmond In Reach program, Richmond practices need-blind admission for U.S. citizens and permanent residents and commits to meeting 100% of demonstrated need as determined by the Office of Financial Aid.

sources.title: Need-Based Aid - Financial Aid - University of Richmond
sources.quote: Through this program, Richmond commits to meeting 100% of our students' demonstrated need, as determined by the Office of Financial Aid. Plus, if you are a U.S. citizen or permanent resident, we practice need-blind admission

facts.text: Beginning in fall 2025, Richmond's Promise to Virginia funds 100% of the cost of tuition, housing, and food for qualified Virginia students whose parental income is $75,000 or less.

sources.title: Richmond's Promise to Virginia - Financial Aid - University of Richmond
sources.quote: Beginning in fall 2025, the University of Richmond will fund 100% of the cost of tuition, housing, and food for qualified Virginia students whose parental income is $75,000 or less.
